items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: I never did see Buddy Bowler.

ctx.x: Yeah, he'd stand up and talk to him. He'd listen to four of them. Yeah, they'd want that to hold. Yeah, they'd want that to hold. You don't have to make your music good, you know. First, that's all his playing, all that that. I said, what about him first come from? He ain't got no movement. I never did see Buddy Bowler. That's the fault I sure didn't want to see. Never did see. Bump, I saw Bump. Oh, you jumped. That's what you wanted. I was born from Plackmont. I think so, yeah. Yeah, Plackmont. Yeah, Plackmont.…
Who was that from St. James?
